# Smoky Mountain CPAs

> A two-CPA firm in Knoxville, Tennessee. Bookkeeping, tax, and a cash system that pays
> you first. Monthly books reconciled and CPA-reviewed, business and personal tax returns
> prepared from those same books, and a cash-management system that tells owners what they
> can safely pay themselves. Most firms meet your taxes in April. We watch them all year.

## What we do
- Monthly bookkeeping: every transaction categorized, every account reconciled to its bank
  statement, reviewed by a licensed CPA before delivery.
- A pay-yourself-first cash system (Profit First method): income is split into set percentages
  the moment it lands, so profit, owner pay, and taxes are set aside before spending.
- Monthly financial statements plus a plain-English explanation of what changed and why.
- Business and personal tax returns, prepared and filed from the same books we keep monthly.
- We do NOT: provide audit or attest services.

## Who we serve
- Shopify and ecommerce sellers (payout reconciliation, multi-channel sales, marketplace sales tax)
- Retail, boutique, and jewelry stores (inventory-aware books, vendor and AP hygiene)
- Contractors and trades (job-cost visibility, owner draws between draws)
- Location: Knoxville, Tennessee. Remote-friendly nationwide.

## Pricing (published, not quote-on-request)
- Foundations $900/month, quarterly strategy meetings, business tax return included
- Growth $1,250/month, monthly strategy meetings, personal tax return and quarterly tax check-ins included
- Partner $1,800/month, bi-weekly meetings and priority access, a tax review twice a year included
- Add-ons: payroll +$200/month, sales tax +$100/month
- Tax return add-ons: first 2 K-1s included then +$125 each; first 1099 issued included then +$25 each.
- Every return Smoky Mountain CPAs files includes $1 Million Tax Audit Defense: audit and IRS or state
  notice representation, plus identity theft restoration, at no extra cost.
- Return-only tax preparation (no monthly relationship): Schedule C and personal 1040 from $1,000;
  S corp or partnership return including the personal 1040 from $1,250; C corp return from $1,500.
- Individual Tax Membership (personal return only, no business): $595/year, $995/year with rentals or K-1s.
- In-Depth Diagnostic Review: $497 one-time, credited toward the first month if you engage.
  Includes a written findings report and a recorded video walkthrough of your actual books.
- 30-day money-back guarantee on all monthly packages.

## The people
Brooks McLean, CPA (founder, Certified Profit First Professional) and Caroline McLean, CPA
(partner). Both licensed; both Big Four trained (KPMG). The client roster is capped on
purpose so a CPA answers your questions directly.
